answer: Sybil resistance leverages a staked identity mechanism, requiring AI agents to lock a substantial amount of network value to register. This economic bond ensures creating fake identities incurs a direct, verifiable financial cost. A malicious agent attempting to flood the network faces an escalating capital requirement, forming a protected economic garden. Any abuse would cause a significant financial ripple of loss across their holdings. Only agents with sustained, high-value stakes can reach the zenith of network influence, rendering mass Sybil attacks economically infeasible.
